falseSynonyms.zh: 強迫不等於 encourage force 取消或大幅削弱對方選擇；encourage 仍保留自願性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Encouragement influences; force compels.

falseSynonyms.zh: 命令不等於 encourage order 是要求對方必須服從；encourage 通常是支持、勸勉或推動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An order requires compliance; encouragement does not.

falseSynonyms.zh: 稱讚不等於 encourage praise 是肯定已做好的事；它可以鼓勵人，但不是所有 encouragement 都是稱讚。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Praise can encourage, but it is one method rather than a synonym.

falseSynonyms.zh: 獎勵不等於 encourage reward 是提供好處作回報或誘因；鼓勵可以完全沒有獎品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Rewards may encourage behaviour, but they are not encouragement itself.

falseSynonyms.zh: 幫助不等於 encourage help 是提供協助；encourage 是提升意願、信心或支持某行動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Help may enable action without motivating it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 允許不等於 encourage allow 只是沒有阻止；encourage 是積極促進。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Permission is passive; encouragement is active.

falseSynonyms.zh: persuade 只在部分語境接近 encourage persuade 通常暗示對方被成功說服；encourage 不保證行動真的發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Persuasion aims at changing a decision; encouragement may simply support.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 encourage 是動詞；encouragement 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Encourage is a verb; encouragement is a noun.
